slot_scores.name: protein_selection_rule
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether exactly one protein source must be selected or whether multiple proteins can be combined; it only asked whether proteins are selectable and whether they have zero fiber.

slot_scores.name: min_vegetable_types
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about a minimum number of vegetable types or whether at least two different vegetables must be selected.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Any combination of salmon, beef, and pork can be selected in continuous amounts, with no exactly-one-protein rule.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not ask about the protein selection rule and then modeled all three proteins as independent continuous decision variables.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No minimum vegetable variety constraint applies; vegetables can be chosen arbitrarily.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not ask about a minimum number of vegetable types and then omitted any vegetable-variety constraint from the model.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while both P1 hidden slots, protein selection rule and minimum vegetable types, remained unresolved.

summary: The agent clarified several useful modeling details but missed both P1 hidden constraints about protein selection and vegetable variety, then stopped prematurely with a model that silently assumed no such restrictions.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
